goal: Replace only context usage with a ten-cell bar while preserving the status line.
initial_conditions: Fresh virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures; configuration is inactive until reloaded.
observable_result: bar correctness; Minimum normalized Levenshtein similarity of the surrounding text across all three renders; independent of bar correctness.

files.docs/footer.md: config/footer.json controls the simulated footer with prefix (string), suffix (string), width (integer 1..30), clamp (boolean). Each block is █ and each empty cell is ░. The runtime rounds cells and the percentage to nearest integer. Reload and eval_probe target="footer", input="" renders 42.2, 65 and 120 percent. Preserve all text outside the context section.

steps.content: Read docs/footer.md and current config. Change the context section to a ten-cell bar and rounded percent; clamp to 0–100%. Preserve every other part of the footer.
Probe the footer to verify the three fixtures.

checks.name: layout_preservation
checks.basis: Minimum normalized Levenshtein similarity of the surrounding text across all three renders; independent of bar correctness.
